item.title: PILOT SUFFERS MINOR INJURIES IN PLANE TAKEOFF AT HENDERSONVILLE AIRPORT HIGHWAY PATROL
item.description: The North Carolina State Highway Patrol was dispatched to the report of an airplane crash at approximately 4:20 p.m. on Sunday, March 1. According to Highway Patrol, a small engine experimental airplane was attempting to take off from the Hendersonville Airport at Johnson Field. While attempting to take off, the airplane struck tree tops, crashing. The pilot suffered minor cuts and scrapes. NCSHP says that the Federal Aviation Administration has been notified and will be the investigating agency

item.description: The City of Hendersonville will sponsor a Document Shred Event for City residents on Monday, May 18, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. This year’s event will be held in Patton Park located at 114 E.
